relations.reading: Narrative compression becomes operationally consequential when the simplified model is used as the control surface for decisions that depend on omitted conditions.

relations.title: Remanente no recuperable
relations.reading: Reconstructing what a model omitted is different from recovering a capability that has ceased to be exercised; the bridge note keeps those repair problems distinct.

relations.title: Contribución y reconocimiento
relations.reading: One testable link is whether the visible model receives resources and credit while the less visible capabilities on which it depends remain under-attributed.

relations.title: Traducción de captura a arquitectura
relations.reading: The Level 1.5 transition offers a practical check on narrative compression by tracing how field observations, dependencies and responsibilities become architecture.

relations.title: Secuencia JUBAP
relations.reading: The JUBAP sequence is more useful when each stage retains the capabilities and operating conditions required for it to work, rather than becoming a ritualized checklist.

relations.title: Capacidad interna después de la salida
relations.reading: The HR rationalization case makes the distinction concrete: preparing an executable architecture and handover is a different result from completing the full rollout.

relations.title: Ciclo exploración–explotación
relations.reading: The invisible-talent model offers a useful counterpoint to symbolic celebration: capability remains alive through formation, operational missions and opportunities to exercise judgment.

relations.title: Contribución y reconocimiento
relations.reading: Narrative compression is one possible visibility mechanism to examine when contribution and attribution diverge; it should be traced through actual resource and authority decisions.

relations.title: Procedencia auditable
relations.reading: Narrative convergence should not be counted as independent corroboration when several statements inherit the same underlying source or compressed frame.
